title: Teodoro says ASEAN members back PH handling of ADMM-Plus, rejects China’s obstruction claim
summary: Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Tuesday said ASEAN member states supported the Philippines' handling of the ASEAN Defense Ministers' Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus), rejecting China's accusation…

blocks.text: Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Tuesday said ASEAN member states supported the Philippines' handling of the ASEAN Defense Ministers' Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus), rejecting China's accusation that Manila deliberately obstructed Beijing's participation in the regional security mechanism.
